caveats: Manual rectangles are exploratory, not pixel-level FMB semantic labels.
ROIs were selected from scenes used in previous exploratory checks; results must not be used for parameter tuning.
Thermal intensity grayscale has no direct physical temperature calibration.
Brightness contrast is not target detection recall nor mIoU.
10 re-packaged FMB/test images are not the official 280-image benchmark.
